blocks.text: LUCENA CITY — Quezon Vice Gov. Anacleto Alcala III on Wednesday urged Filipinos to instill patriotism in the young generation as the province commemorated the 185th death anniversary of revolutionary hero Apolinario de la Cruz, popularly known as Hermano Puli. “Let us continue to raise awareness among the younger generation, not only across Quezon but throughout the nation, so that Hermano Puli’s sacrifice will forever serve as a guiding beacon,” Alcala said during a commemorative ceremony at the hero’s shrine along the Maharlika Highway in Tayabas City. “May the soul and spirit of Hermano Puli continue to inspire us as we […]...
